name: cli-mode
description: Persistent CLI-agent routing through ACPX with queued forwarding and public activity: Antigravity, Claude Code, Grok Build, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Codex CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Use six persistent CLI agents through ACPX: send a prompt to one with /d.
interface.longDescription: CLI-MODE sends /d prompts to persistent, named CLI agents (several at once, each with its own queue); every other message stays with the host. Select an agent with /cli or /cli <agent>. Each backend provides setup, public tool and message progress, and the quota reporting its runtime supports.
